result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly; the main issues are a nonsensical discount badge and an image that appears to be a placeholder in one restaurant card.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card displays '-0%', which is a meaningless/incorrect discount value and looks broken to users.
issues.suggestion: Suppress the discount badge when the discount is 0% (or display the real discount value), so no meaningless '-0%' badge is shown.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card shows a small, centered dish image on a large flat light-gray background, unlike the full-bleed photos of the other restaurant cards. It looks like a missing or low-resolution image asset/placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Use a full-bleed, adequately sized photo consistent with the other cards, or show a proper placeholder/loading state if the image failed to load.
